column1: # Known cases for gm's secret masking (tracing-design.md, Retention and redaction): input, a tab, the text gm must store.
# tests/run.sh sends each input as a Bash command through the PreToolUse hook and reads back what the register holds.
# Token shapes are written with {} inside them so this file is not itself a secret-scanning hit; the test removes every {}.
cat > id <<EOT{nl}-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIV{}ATE KEY-----{nl}b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAA{nl}Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED{nl}-----END OPENSSH PRIV{}ATE KEY-----{nl}EOT
git commit -m "fix the task-list and disk-usage views"
